**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- **Rule NONCOMPETE** is satisfied at the *preferred* position: the agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, field-of-use or territory restriction on AP.
- Clause 1 (p0001) affirmatively helps us: it disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP may offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties.
- The only Customer-side prohibitions (p0025) are standard license-scope/IP protections (no transfer or third-party access, no reverse engineering or derivative works, no resale/service-bureau use of Kubient's Service). These restrict use of the Vendor's technology, not AP's lines of business, products it may buy, or anything it may build independently — so they fall outside this rule.
- No post-term restraint exists, so the walk-away trigger is not in play.
